card.name: Just before a minus sign or dash
card.fires_on: The last word or number just before a minus sign, hyphen or dash that begins a negative value or range, mostly in data tables and formulas.

modes.label: Before negative range
modes.description: The word 'range' with colon, right before a dash and a negative or low-to-high range.

modes.label: Table or formula values
modes.description: A number or variable right before a minus sign in a table row or equation.

modes.label: Command output or charge
modes.description: A word or digit followed by a dash, as in a file listing or an ion charge.

card.writes: It promotes spaced dash and minus tokens and suppresses the attached forms, so the next text is a separate dash.
card.plain: It fires on the spot just before a minus sign or dash that starts a negative number or range.
